title: New York Urban Wildlife Sunset Boat Tour
includes: One complimentary beer, wine, champagne, or soda is included
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We recommend bringing binoculars for this tour!
Please coordinate with the operator in advance if assistance is required for boarding or if you have any questions about general accessibility. Accessibility varies by boat
Service animals are permitted; Emotional Support animals and pets are not permitted
Large group bookings are not permitted. Multiple bookings are subject to added fees or cancellation by operator
A small sandwich display is included with a meat and vegetarian option. Guests with dietary restrictions are welcome to bring their own snack
Our Urban Naturalists vary - either Gabriel Willow or Russell Jacobs will guide this tour
Elegant tables assigned to each booking. Tables may be shared with a clear partition divider depending on party size
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us aboard one of our classic boats, Manhattan or Manhattan II, for a captivating narrated boat cruise through New York Harbor's historic waterways! Embark on a journey of discovery as we cruise past Belmont Island, Roosevelt Island, Mill Rock, and North and South Brother Islands and learn about the area's rich history and wildlife. 

Guests aboard will learn fascinating tales from our expert guide and renowned Urban Naturalist, Gabriel Willow or Russell Jacobs, as we hope to witness a variety of bird species, including water birds, egrets, herons, gulls and more, nesting on North Brother and South Brother Islands. We recommend bringing binoculars! 

We'll also see other iconic landmarks including One World Trade, the Manhattan skyline, Brooklyn Bridge, and more! Join us for an unforgettable journey where history and nature come together with New York City as our backdrop.
